acceptance_gate_results.principle: A positive scientific metric cannot excuse invalid evidence.
A valid null must not suppress an independent measurement.
A small sample, a favorable seed or an analytic fixture cannot substitute for held-out value.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Use unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF for current model tasks and also emit lowercase model_specs.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Each check carries category, expected, observed, operator, result and a failure-prevention principle.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure current work without padding; separate load, forward, generation, numeric work and validation.
field_principles.execution_venue: Use host and record actual CPU and CUDA identities; historical board evidence is separate.
field_principles.field_principles: Explain why each required field exists so the evidence stands alone.
field_principles.flagged_adversarial: Keep real reader flags; never clear a flag to open a gate.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked verdict names the failed check, upstream field, expected value and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use a complete terminal finding while keeping predictive benefit and scored deployment deferred.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Name the actual native raw-logit readout without claiming generation or parity.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use model_load_no_generation because the model loads and evaluates prompts but generates zero tokens.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Balance attempted, complete, failed, cancelled and in-flight loads, forwards and generations.
field_principles.model_invoked: Any attempted current model call differs from archived or scripted events.
field_principles.native_readout_ready_score: Bare 0 or 1 for live native transport; accuracy is not a validity precondition.
field_principles.phase_spans: Timestamped flushed progress and checkpoints expose long silent or unfinished operations.
field_principles.pilot_cost_rows: Per-prompt prefill and load costs support honest capture feasibility.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Name resources, exact paths, ownership and observed prerequisite values before dependent work.
field_principles.prompt_identity: Exact model, template, token IDs and logit positions make scores reproducible.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze ordering and audit seeds; the deterministic transport reducer uses no outcome-selected seed.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, protocol, data roles, model identity, raw rows and validation scope.
field_principles.rows: One row per forward includes failures and censoring so difficult prompts cannot disappear.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260921; retain measured UTC and monotonic times with clock/process identity.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Separate planned, attempted, complete, failed, censored, excluded and unstarted units.
field_principles.schema: Versioned schema with exact roadmap experiment_id, milestone and terminal status prevents silent reader drift.
field_principles.scored_runtime_parity_score: Remain 0 because no exact scored-runtime comparison occurs.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Preserve exact upstream bytes and their original flags and classes.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Exact commands, exit codes, log hashes and required status establish validation scope.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the closed verdict enum; this valid transport-only result is a scientific null.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False prevents transport fixtures from becoming positive predictive evidence.
